title: Weeknotes #2026
content:
This week has been a fucking week. On Monday night I was all of a sudden very dizzy and being sick, passed out in bed, and the next morning I was still just as dizzy. Ended up being taken to A&E and being treated for a possible stroke which turned out to just be an ear infection but that was a scary 24 hours. I spent the rest of the week in bed and even as I write this I’m still a bit dizzy. Fucking ears, man. What are you even doing.

As soon as I’m better I’m going to KFC to get some Doomsday Colonel figures and some of that doom dust because I need it for my work.

It's taking all my willpower not to order these nostalgia-bait Sony headphones. I'll wait for Davey's review. Update: he already wrote it

If you've seen traffic from aocr.org in your analytics, it's a bot because of course it is. I'm blocking it in nginx like so:

if ($http_referer ~* "^https?://(www\.)?aocr\.org(/|:|$)") {
    return 444;
}

Antou released this nifty magnetic pen dock. I don't need it but I do want it.

The C100 camera I mentioned last week can be hacked to take dithered photos. Makes me want one even more.

An excellent list of paper planes with instructions and ratings for difficulty, speed, glide, and accuracy.

I have no use for Tiny Hand but I love it.

My first time going to Walmart is my new favourite video.

Gladden have a new two player notebook game which looks cool if you have a friend I suppose.
